Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp176-img1.png) to open Radar prediction tool.
Radar Prediction is a tool that lets you calculate predictions on radars. Depending on the view angle and the size of the radar, Radar Predictions will show the reach of radar signals.
![Image p176](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp176-img2.png)
**Calculation settings**
**Calculation name**
Name of the calculation that will be displayed in Prediction history.
**Resolution**
Prediction raster cell size in meters.
**Best server count**
Option to calculate up to 5 best servers.
**Radar template**
If the radar misses the required parameters, the parameters from the template will be used.
**Target cross-section, m^2**
This parameter describes the target size in square meters.
**Selected**
Current amount of selected radars.
**Results:**
- Field Strength raster in dBm
